in_hebrew.name: אֶסִילְדָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אֶסִילְדָה (Esilda) היא שם נשים שמי-כנעני, הנגזר מ- אלאלי (Esil) - 'הצלה' ו-אאולה (Dah) - 'אלה'. אלאלי- אולה יללויל עבל לילוו, בי הרה עבל אראעיל, אלאייול ילולאור מאירה הרה.

in_greek.name: Εσίλδα
in_greek.long_meaning: Η ονομασία Εσίλδα (Esilda) κατάγεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα, και σημαίνει αγία σωτήρια. Η Εσίλδα ήταν μια χριστιανή σωτήρια που ζούσε στην εποχή των αποστόλων.

in_latin.name: Esilda
in_latin.long_meaning: Esilda, nomen femininum, ex ebraico derivatum, significat Salvator Domina. In historia Ecclesiae, Esilda fuit una ex mulieribus sanctis, qui cum Christo Jesu et Apostolis cooperabantur.

in_english.name: Esilda
in_english.long_meaning: Esilda is a feminine given name derived from the Hebrew language, meaning Salvation of God. It is a rare and unique name with spiritual significance in Christian tradition, associated with the concept of salvation and redemption.

data.cultural_impact: Esilda as a name does not have a settled cultural significance as it is not a well-known name globally. However, due to its Latin origin, it can be connected to the rich history of the Roman Empire and the spread of Christianity from Europe.

Those named Esilda are emboldened to trust in the power and love of God during their struggles, knowing that He will see them through and emerge stronger and more holy.

The "da" suffix represents a gift or gifted one, signifying the divine guidance and support received during these trials.
